text: In TextOS, sources are read in a dedicated step that does not run inside writing, with a budget, one request at a time per site, and the option to resume or cancel. TextOS reads robots.txt first, and when a page cannot be read, the reason is recorded in a log that is only ever appended to. Nothing read this way turns into a statement by itself; it becomes material for a person to look at. That is the whole difference between reading the web and repeating it.
